TECHLOGISTICS 2025

Following the success of the first edition in 2023—where we provided a unique platform to explore the latest trends in technology and innovation within the transport and logistics industry—we are pleased to announce that the 3rd edition of TechLogistics took place on June 25, 2025, at Microsoft Portugal.

TechLogistics 2025 once again aimed to bring together leading professionals and enthusiasts from the Logistics and Supply Chain sectors from across Portugal.

With a strong focus on technology and innovation, we are committed to delivering an even more enriching and inspiring experience for all participants.
